subject: [PATCH v3 1/2] scsi: mpt3sas: Serialize interrupt-time sdev block with hostdata teardown

2026-11-06.patch_summary: This patch serializes the teardown of hostdata associated with SCSI devices (sdev) to prevent use-after-free issues. It introduces a new lock, ioc->block_lock, which is taken in _scsih_block_io_device() for each sdev and around setting and clearing sdev->hostdata in scsih_sdev_init() and scsih_sdev_destroy(). This ensures that hostdata and its target are live while the lock is held. The patch addresses a bug introduced by a previous commit (f92363d12359) and fixes a use-after-free issue.
